thread:
noah_billops: Heads-up: VegaHealth reports an unexpected true-up charge on their private deployment renewal invoice. They say usage matches committed GPU hours but platform fee markup looks off. cc @anya_csm @sam_sales

anya_csm: Vega provided their committed capacity PDF. The platform fee on renewal INV-2026-410 is $6,000 but previous renewal was $4,000. Sales confirms no formal platform fee increase in the signed SOW.

sam_sales: I checked the SOW system: the SOW attached to Vega is SOW-2024-77 signed 2024-09-15. Platform fee column shows $4,000/year. No amendment exists.

price-bot: Pricing policy: platform_fee escalation clause allows market adjustments annually but requires 30 days notice. No notice recorded for Vega. PRICING-ATTACH: escalation_notice_sent=false.

noah_billops: Could be mapping issue where platform_fee for their customer_id mapped to newer global default. Need audit trail on who last changed platform fee mapping for customer.

billing-bot: Audit log: platform_fee override for customer vega-health set to 6000 by user ops-admin on 2026-03-20. Source: override_api.

anya_csm: Who is ops-admin? That's an internal automation account for onboarding scripts. Might've been a migration job.

price-bot: Called pricing-migrations: migration MIG-2026-03-defaults applied on 2026-03-20. This job applied default platform_fee values for customers missing explicit override. It appears Vega had explicit $4k but migration overwrote it due to schema mismatch.

noah_billops: Proposed customer remediation: reinstate $4k platform fee for the renewal, issue credit for $2k and set migration rollback flag. Also include explanation and offer 1-month free managed support as goodwill.

sam_sales: Approved reinstating $4k and issuing credit. Goodwill offer ok but check budget with sales ops.

price-bot: Marking PRICING-MIG-2026 for rollback and creating follow-up ticket PRICING-433. Include test to prevent migration from overwriting explicit SOW values.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-097 for $2,000; status pending. Attach audit note referencing MIG-2026-03-defaults.

anya_csm: Draft customer note: 

"""
Hi Vega team,

We identified an internal migration error that incorrectly updated your platform fee. We're reinstating your contracted platform fee of $4,000 and will issue a $2,000 credit to correct the renewal invoice. We'll also include one month of managed support complimentary. Apologies for the disruption.

Best, Anya
"""

noah_billops: Logging thread for finance audit. Follow-up: confirm credit applied and migration tests added before closing.
